name: Sentinel Augustus
speaker: entity:sentinel_augustus
lines: *Augustus' face darkens, and his voice drops low.* I made a promise. ...My village was attacked by marauders. We wouldn't give them our winter stockpile. They torched the place in response. ...We fought. Many died. My parents, and two siblings... By the time the navy patrol could help us, it was just me and two of my siblings left. ...The three of us swore a vow that night. That we would leave our past behind, and join [the Authority](faction:the_central_authority), in order to avenge our kin. So we did.

*He lowers his head, in thanks and mourning.* That's all in the past now. Even if I still dream about that night... My surviving siblings still serve the Authority in the heartlands - my brother as a High Inquisitor, and my sister as a Navy Captain. Myself, I got deployed to Merit in my first assignments, then I joined the Shock Corps.

*His tone gains an air of reverence and vengeance.* The previous Sentinel, [Faris Kesset](entity:sentinel_faris_kesset), fell in battle against [General Titus Fulminus Destellus](entity:titus_fulminus_destellus). *His fist clenches* I've sought to avenge her ever since...

*He puffs out his chest with pride, his facial expression suggesting a solemn hubris.* Who else, soldier? I was en route to a different mission in Aratel with the Shock Corps when we ran into him running a small detachment with a few Legion Shock Troopers. He gave us a run for our money, I'll admit - but we captured him all the same.

*The sentinel frowns.* He was a real pain to our behinds when he was free. See myself, I'm the kind of officer who does best following our great Warden's orders. But Destellus... I hate to admit it, but his might rivals mine, and his mind rivals Warden Jericho's. He'd catch us in ambushes, set traps for us, and always be three steps ahead of us. When outnumbered, he would often survive just through sheer strength and discipline. I couldn't stand it.

*His brow quivers, a defiant spark of pride flashing in his eyes.* Good question, Operator. In the end, during our skirmish, it came down to a showdown between me and him. I guess I was stronger. *He tilts his head to the side, revealing a gnarly scar to you.* He left me with a parting gift before he surrendered.

*Augustus seems blindsided by your question. He holds his breath for a moment, but your verbal jab finally breaks his silence.* ...I guess it's somethin' I've been too proud to admit myself. Reassuring myself that I'm stronger than the man who's been our - my - nemesis on the field for so long. And maybe I am. But... Something was off, when we fought in Aratel. I can't put my finger on it. It felt like he wasn't giving it his all.
